description: The pooled DRN of the four months with a neural correction of EMOS (EMOS fitted per month) and with neighbourhood inputs, January-initialized FMAM (scripts/pooled_benchmark.py, docs/54 section 3g).
external_note: EMOS is read from the second stage (neural_ext), which fits it on the same folds and scores it with the same rule (scoring version 2); the pooled DRN is refitted here as the control.
